topic: teardown of a fictional HVAC site: headline, chat pop-up, long form
hook: This HVAC site loses you 3 calls before anyone can book.
caption:
Comment WEBSITE and I'll do this teardown on your site for free.

Bellcrest is made up. The problems are not.

I see these 3 on real HVAC sites every week: a headline that says Welcome instead of what you fix, a chat bubble parked on top of the Call button, and a form with 11 boxes that nobody with a dead furnace in January is going to finish.

Fix all 3. Then the page does its 1 job, which is making your phone ring.

#hvac #hvaccontractor #smallbusiness
